context.summary: Gold-polymer hybrid nanoparticle (CRISPR-AuNP): citrate AuNP cores conjugated with Cas9/Cas12a RNP-thiolated PEI-PEG polyplexes for non-viral gene editing of CD34+ HSPCs; three formulation generations optimized (loading, DLS, zeta, editing).

samples.name: AuNP cores (Turkevich citrate)
samples.composition: citrate-reduced spherical gold nanoparticles, ~17 nm core

samples.name: 2nd generation CRISPR-AuNP (P10PSH-coated)
samples.composition: Cas9 RNP on AuNP core, coated with P10PSH copolymer (PEI 2k-g-10% PEG 2k-SH) in 10 mM HEPES

samples.name: 2nd generation AuNP/RNP complex (before polymer coating)
samples.composition: pre-formed Cas9 RNP conjugated to AuNP core at acidic pH, no copolymer

samples.name: P10PSH-RNP polyplexes (N/P 2-64)
samples.composition: Cas9 RNP with P10PSH copolymer at various N/P ratios, no AuNP

samples.name: 3rd generation CRISPR-AuNP (P20PSH, N/P 2)

samples.name: P20PSH polyplexes alone
samples.composition: Cas9 RNP + P20PSH copolymer without AuNP

samples.composition: Cas12a RNP + P20PSH + AuNP (3rd generation scheme)

context.summary: Microwave-assisted green synthesis of silver nanoparticles using naringin and/or pectin (N-, P-, NP-AgNPs1 3:1, NP-AgNPs2 1:3); physicochemical characterization (UV-vis, FTIR, SEM, TEM, EDS, XRD, DLS, zeta, TGA) and antibacterial activity.
